Koehres seed gallery — photos matched to seed items

We are only shoppers of kaktus-koehres.de. Their picture gallery can be browsed by first letter only, and their seed listings carry no photos at all — so we put the two together here: every picture of the gallery, next to the seed item it belongs to.

Nothing is sold on this page. The photos are the shop's own, hotlinked from their server, and the file name under each one is theirs as well — use it to check that a picture really belongs to the seed item.

13 genera so far. We have done Aeonium, Agave, Aloe, Crassula, Echeveria, Graptopetalum, Greenovia, Haworthia, Jovibarba, Kalanchoe, Lithops, Pachyphytum, Sedum — 705 seed items in all — but the shop sells seeds of some 140 genera (Euphorbia, Senecio, Stapelia, Pelargonium, Pleiospilos, cactus and orchid seeds too), and its picture gallery covers every letter of the alphabet. The rest could be put together the same way; this is the beginning of the job rather than the end of it.
exact = the whole gallery name is explained by the seed name; typo-tolerant = matched despite the site's own spelling drift; species-only = same genus + species but the variety/locality differs (related photo, not a guaranteed match); no photo = the shop has no photo for that item at all. One picture may illustrate only one line item, so a photo that fits two lines goes to the better match and the other line shows none.

In the photo gallery view every picture of the gallery is listed, each one labelled with the seed line it sits on. no seed line means no listing explains that picture's whole name — usually the photo carries a locality the listing leaves out (La Salitrera, Putla), or the shop does not sell that plant as seed at all.
434/705 seed items have a photo · 315 exact · 25 typo-tolerant · 94 species-only · 271 with no gallery photo
2196 gallery photos of these genera in total · 1306 sit on a seed line · 890 do not
